title: Integrative brain transcriptome analysis links complement component 4 and HSPA2 to the APOE ε2 protective effect in Alzheimer disease

evidence_spans.quote: We analyzed gene expression data derived from autopsied brains donated by 982 individuals
protective effect of apolipoprotein E ( APOE ) ε2 against Alzheimer disease

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an original analysis of human brain gene-expression data in Alzheimer disease, but it does not analyze or explicitly frame a construct as biological aging or an aging process.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: APOE ε2/ε3 genotype among Alzheimer disease cases
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Gene expression, including C4A and C4B differential expression
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Differential gene expression between ε2/ε3 AD cases and controls

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report completed a real-data transcriptome analysis, but the stated design is a naturally occurring human case/control and genotype-group comparison, not a qualifying applied causal or perturbation design.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports associations and a role in an existing protective effect, but no matching current-result directional X-to-Y assertion.
